articles.summary: Surajit Datta joins Kodiak AI as Chief Financial Officer, bringing deep finance expertise to support Kodiak’s public listing and advance autonomous trucking technology.
articles.title: Kodiak AI Appoints Surajit Datta as Chief Financial Officer

articles.summary: Kodiak AI has integrated NXP’s ISO 26262-compliant processors and interfaces into its autonomous trucking system, strengthening safety, reliability, and real-time vehicle control.
articles.title: Kodiak AI Taps NXP's ISO 26262-Compliant Processors and Interfaces to Help Operate Autonomous Trucks
